heartauth.title: HeartAuth Project
heartauth.description: HeartAuth is a biometric authentication system that uses the unique rhythm of the human heart as a key to verify identity. Instead of passwords or codes, the system analyzes an individual’s ECG signal, introducing a new way of logging in. HeartAuth seamlessly integrates with existing identity management systems such as Keycloak and requires no additional infrastructure. Thanks to the OAuth2 standard, it enables easy integration with any applications and services. It’s a new era of digital security — your heart becomes your password.
